canonical_name: Hoffman spectral bound for independent sets (repository theorem-family label)
literal_source_claim_en: A spectral upper bound for independent sets.
source_attribution: Alan Hoffman, 1970 (uncited catalog metadata; historically disputed for the independence-number ratio bound)
canonical_statement: For every finite nonempty simple graph G that is regular of positive natural degree k, if lambda_min is the least real eigenvalue of G's adjacency matrix, then alpha(G) <= |V(G)| * (-lambda_min) / (k - lambda_min).
canonical_claim: Haemers 2021 Theorem 1 regular unweighted simple-graph independence-number ratio bound, with positive degree explicit to exclude the printed quotient's edgeless zero-denominator boundary
target_decision: select Haemers 2021 Section 2 Theorem 1 as the exact conventional Hoffman independent-set bound matching the repository gloss; retain H1 for disputed publication history and independent source review
